verdict.rationale: First-party docs show several natural-language surfaces. These include Copilot Chat and agent mode in the editor, a CLI in the terminal with voice prompts, `@copilot` mentions on pull requests, and assigning tasks to autonomous cloud agents. Together they let a user operate the product by describing what they want. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration that natural-language commands work reliably across these surfaces, since community evidence mostly concerns completions.
